packageRules.description: Analyzer packages all gate the build through the same warnings-as-errors pass, so landing them separately just means several red CI runs in a row. Move them in one PR.
Packaging, versioning and symbol tooling. These affect how the package is produced, never the shipped API, so they are safe to move as one.

Verify.TUnit is built against a specific TUnit version. The shared preset groups TUnit separately from Verify.*, which can split a matched pair across two PRs and red the build; keep them together here.
SQLite3MC is a drop-in SQLitePCLRaw bundle and shares its native ABI, so it has to move in step with SQLitePCLRaw.core and the bundles. The shared preset only matches the SQLitePCLRaw prefix.
Newtonsoft.Json.Bson tracks the Newtonsoft.Json version it was built against.
Test and benchmark helpers that sit outside the framework cohorts the shared preset already groups.
